name: Verify completion documents for billing readiness in Google Sheets

parameters.content:
# Proof-to-Payment Control Tower

Convert completion evidence into a billing decision.

1. Capture a PDF or image from Gmail or a webhook.
2. Extract reference, signature, date, confidence, and readability with your selected AI model.
3. Reconcile against Dispatches, POD Register, and Billing Ready.
4. Archive evidence, prevent duplicates, and apply the billing policy.
5. Route records to Billing Ready or Review Queue.
6. Release reviewer approvals and send daily cash-risk actions.

## Before activation

Configure Set Template Fields, connect credentials, use a dedicated Gmail label, and test one valid document, one exception, one approval, and one late job.

## Capture documents

Gmail watches a dedicated label. The webhook accepts the same file from a portal, scanner, driver app, or another workflow.

Each file receives a unique Document Key.

## Daily cash-risk trigger

Runs the weekday audit and marks this execution as a daily audit before the shared router.

## Reviewer release trigger

Runs every 15 minutes and reads pending decisions without keeping an execution open.

## Configure and route

Set Template Fields centralizes sheet IDs, tab names, Drive folder, recipients, thresholds, and the AI model.

The router selects document intake, daily audit, or reviewer release.

## Route scheduled work

Non-document executions route to daily cash-risk or reviewer release.

Only scheduled paths use this lane.

## Prepare AI input

Keep supported files only, then create traceability and correlation keys before the AI request.

## Extract and normalize

Read the completion document with your selected vision model and normalize reference, date, recipient, signature, confidence, and readability.

## Load reconciliation sources

Read Dispatches, POD Register, and Billing Ready.

Match the normalized dispatch reference — never an item index.

## Reconcile and score

Detect duplicates, match expected work, and calculate an explainable evidence score.

Exceptions retain the exact reason for review.

## Archive evidence safely

Archive the source file in Google Drive, then restore the original context through its unique archive key.

## Log the POD decision

Write the evidence decision, score, document key, source metadata, and Drive link to the permanent POD Register.

## Queue reviewer follow-up

Unreadable, unsigned, unmatched, or low-confidence evidence enters Review Queue with the reason and Drive link.

The reviewer chooses Approve or Reject.

## Write Billing Ready

This clean queue is the only hand-off point for invoicing or ERP automation after the evidence policy passes.

## Compare expected and billable work

Find completed jobs beyond the grace period that still lack billing-ready evidence.

## Send owner action lists

Each owner receives late dispatches, amounts at risk, and overdue hours.

The reviewer is the fallback recipient.

## Prepare reviewer decisions

Only unprocessed Approve or Reject decisions continue.

Billing Ready is checked again to keep the release idempotent.

## Release approved evidence

Approved records enter Billing Ready once, then the review row is stamped.

Rejections and failed writes remain safely auditable.
